text:
Sam (Marketing): Urgent - Priya found a discrepancy in the latency table for the benchmark post. Seeing ~12% lower median for model-B than our local runs. We should hold publish until we confirm.
Ivy (PR): Where is this appearing? Is it in the draft blog or the public preview?
Priya (Data): It	is in the draft post (bench-2026-07) in the 'Latency by sequence length' chart. I re-ran the analysis and the csv used for the chart has a missing row (aggregation bug).
Diego (Eng-ML): Can you paste the failing command or commit id?
Priya (Data): Repro steps: 
```
python run_analysis.py --input results/bench-2026-07/raw.csv --agg median
# bad row: sequence_len==64 had index off-by-one in aggregator
```
Ivy (PR): Ok. Action: put a temporary hold on distribution and notify any reporters with embargo access. Who has the preview list?
Sam (Marketing): We gave embargoed previews to 4 outlets: TechWire, The Ledger, ComputeDaily, and SpotCheck.
publish-bot: embargo.access_revoke  post_id=bench-2026-07; revoked_for=[TechWire,The Ledger,ComputeDaily,SpotCheck] at 1755554350
Ivy (PR): Sending a short "hold" note now. Draft: "We discovered an internal data issue and are pausing the embargoed preview. Please hold publication until we confirm updated results. Apologies for the inconvenience." Thoughts?
Rory (Legal): Keep it factual. Add: "We will follow up with revised assets as soon as analysis is complete." Avoid admitting fault language.
Sam (Marketing): Fine. Ivy, please send and cc ops and the reporter contacts spreadsheet.
Ivy (PR): Sent. Copy: 
---
Hi — quick update: weaced an internal data issue and are pausing the embargoed preview for our upcoming benchmark. Please do not publish until you receive our revised notice. We'll update you within 3 hours. Apologies and thanks for understanding.
Best, Ivy (Redwood Inference)
---
Priya (Data): Re-running full aggregation now on a clean dataset. ETA ~45 mins. I'll post a summary and the updated csv when done.
Diego (Eng-ML): If it's the aggregator, we should add a quick unit test to prevent regressions. I can PR a test after we confirm the fix.
Sam (Marketing): Marketing ops: don't touch scheduled publish in CMS yet. We'll only push when we have updated figures and signoff from Data + PR.
publish-bot: scheduled_post.update  post_id=bench-2026-07; old_time=15:00 PT; new_time=15:00 PT (no change) at 1755554400
Ivy (PR): Also flagging partners list — newsletters that referenced the 16:15 window. We'll delay partner newsletter scheduling until we confirm.
Jordan (CEO): Loop me in with a short note if revised numbers change messaging (e.g., relative perf order). I don't need raw numbers, just whether claims shift.
Priya (Data): Update: found the off-by-one in aggregator code (indexing in groupby). Fixed and re-run started at 1755554600. Current re-run shows model-B median aligns with local at ~9% higher latency than model-A (so ranks unchanged).
Sam (Marketing): Good news if ranks unchanged. Priya, can you produce an abbreviated erratum paragraph we can include if numbers change?
Priya (Data): Sure — draft: "An earlier version of the benchmark contained an aggregation error that affected a subset of latency measurements. We have corrected the issue and updated the results; the corrected data does not change the overall conclusion of the analysis. We apologize for the error and maintain our commitment to transparency."
Rory (Legal): Good. Keep it brief, no technical blame.
Ivy (PR): Will prepare a short press note and an FAQ line. If partners ask for details, give the erratum paragraph and offer to follow up.
publish-bot: assets.upload  post_id=bench-2026-07; asset=erratum-note.txt by Priya at 1755554802
Sam (Marketing): Next steps: Priya finalizes csv + chart (by +60 mins), Diego adds test, Ivy prepares press note, Sam reviews and greenlights publish or new schedule.
Ivy (PR): If we can confirm by 60m and ranks unchanged, let's stick to the original publish time and send a short note to reporters about the correction when we publish. If not, push to next slot and notify partners.
Priya (Data): Final CSV + updated chart uploaded at 1755554960. Summary: numbers corrected, no rank flips.
Sam (Marketing): Reviewing now.
Jordan (CEO): Thanks team. Appreciate the quick handling. Keep me posted if messaging needs to shift.
Sam (Marketing): Review complete. We're good to restore embargo previews and proceed with 15:00 PT publish. Ivy, send release-ready assets at T-60.
Ivy (PR): Will do. Sending reporters a short follow-up with the erratum paragraph and updated assets.
Maya (Social): (added later) staging social copy to include note: "Updated results: minor correction; conclusions unchanged."
Sam (Marketing): Closing loop here. Documenting timeline for postmortem in #postmortems if required.
Ivy (PR): Thanks all.
